narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On November 6, 2024, at approximately 0820 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at the Greyhound station in Battle Creek, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Guatemala and that he has no documents allowing him to be in the United States. He showed a Guatemalan identity document (DPI).
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he arrived in the United States near El Paso, Texas, in May 2019, and that he stayed with an aunt in El Paso for several months before moving north.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear.
